d: A shocking incident from Gurugram has raised serious questions about misuse of authority. A Home Guard personnel allegedly stopped a car during duty, wished the occupants Happy Diwali and then demanded a festive gift. When the brother refused, the Home Guard reportedly insisted on getting a gift hamper before allowing the car to leave. The entire incident was recorded on camera. The video went viral on social media, following which Gurugram Police identified the accused as Home Guard personnel Omkar. An FIR was registered against him under Section 308(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita…
